Fixing components for coolrooms and commercial insulated wall
envelopes
retrieval.rag_summary:
Metecno Accessory encompasses
specialized installation hardware, perimeter flashings, fasteners, and sealants
used in conjunction with Metecno / Bondor insulated composite sandwich panels
(such as MetecnoPanel, MetecnoSpan, and MetecnoCoffer). These accessories
maintain airtight, weather-tight, and thermally isolated connections across
commercial coolrooms, architectural facades, and industrial roof envelopes.
